name: mirage
text: Understood, all four are on my list: (1) the startup crash and slowness, including pruning the 8 MB bets.json and the 5 s cold start. (2) The chat screen getting stuck under the keyboard. (3) A view that puts PropLine's +EV bets at Novig side by side with what our engine finds. The PropLine +EV sweep was showing 0 rows earlier, so I'll find out why first. (4) The earlier DG1 fixes. I'll build and test these, and tell you here when they're ready. I'm keeping clear of the other session's parlay work. If you have the crash trace or the time it happened, send it, because that will speed up finding the cause.
